gt_provenance.details: Actual smooth/event metrics use dataset gt_dir crops. The hide_reveal row is a GT-crop composite but is explicitly labeled as an oracle upper bound.

score_normalization.details: PSNR/L1/flicker/static ghost are computed directly from render-reference comparisons; no self-normalization by prediction statistics was found.

result_existence.details: Manifest validation ok=true with n_windows=5 and zero errors/warnings; report, summary, and metrics files exist and agree.

dead_code_or_uncalled_metrics.details: Core metrics were called and written, but learned LPIPS and identity-switch metrics were not computed.

scope.details: Five frozen windows from three scenes and one run per condition support a pilot failure verdict, not a broad method-general claim.

eval_type.details: Actual method/control rows are checkpoint-rendered real-GT evaluations; hide_reveal is an oracle GT-crop composite upper bound and must remain separated.
